title: Integrating Psychometrics and Computing Perspectives on Bias and Fairness in Affective Computing: A Case Study of Automated Video Interviews
reasoning: The paper is centrally focused on the ethical evaluation of machine learning systems through the lens of fairness and bias. It explicitly incorporates theories of organizational justice—including distributive, interactional, and procedural fairness—and discusses morality and value judgments as the foundation for defining fairness in high-stakes automated decision-making contexts.
